
## Playback And Navigation Fixes

- Fixed Back handling in trailer overlays, Details and main navigation.
- Improved menu focus tracking and entry into Home, Search, Watchlist and Settings.
- Fixed trailer Start Watching handoff, including player disposal during title/poster updates.
- Prefetch sources and metadata during inline/fullscreen trailers; reuse in-flight work on Start Watching.
- Move secondary playback work after first frame and reduce initial buffering while keeping memory limits.
- Check cloud playback history on playback journeys and use the newest per-title progress, including intentional rewinds.
- Bind progress/resume to the selected profile rather than the player view model's first profile.
- Guard delayed older progress saves, preserve cloud progress timestamps, and avoid reviving cleared progress from an already-applied cloud revision.

Local regression tests pass. Physical two-TV and remote-control validation is still required.
